data.title: Bitcoin Headwinds Are Sign of Monetary Tightening: Acheson
data.description: Jay Jacobs, US head of equity ETFs BlackRock, joins Scarlet Fu and Dushyant Shahrawat on "Bloomberg Crypto." They discuss the attractiveness of the iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF (ticker: IBIT) to investor portfolios.
